chunks: And through him, from Abdullah bin Hammad, from Ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
When al-Qa'im rises, the swords of fighting will be brought down. On each sword will be the name of the man and the name of his father.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the swords when Imam al-Qa'im rises?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Nu'mani highlights a miraculous sign of the reappearance (al-Zuhur) where swords descend from the heavens, inscribed with the names of their rightful wielders, emphasizing divine predestination and individual recognition among the Mahdi's companions. Scholars interpret this as a fulfillment of the promise that God will establish the earth for His righteous servants, linking the physical descent of arms to the spiritual readiness of the believers. It underscores the theme of divine support in the final victory of truth over falsehood, a core tenet of Shia eschatology.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (45) Abdullah bin Hammad narrated from bin Abu Hamza that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said:

“When al-Qa’im rises, the swords will be brought down. On each sword there will be the name of the man, who will use it in fighting, and the name of his father.” O people of understanding! Would you please ponder a little on these traditions that talk about al-Qa’im (as), his conduct, his virtue, the angels, who will support him, his rough cloths and coarse food, his strife to obey Allah, his jihad for the sake of Allah to do away with injustice, oppression and tyranny, and to spread justice, fairness and kindness, the aspects of his companions, who will be three hundred and thirteen men, who will be the rulers of the world and by whom, with the support of the angels, the east and the west will be conquered? It is clear that the high position and honored rank that Allah has granted to Imam al-Mahdi, have not been granted to any of the previous imams (as). Allah has made Imam al-Mahdi (aj) the means that will carry out His promise, which He has promised the Prophet (S) of; to perfect the religion and make it prevail over all religions.
